							call NB(k)
							call GroupAddUnit(er,k)
						endif
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif(IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
		call ZR(u)
		call eF(GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u)),u)
		if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EL')>0)then
			call Eb(u)
		endif
		set t=GetUnitTypeId(u)
		if(t=='h05G')then
			call wf(u)
		elseif(t=='h059')then
			call Jf(u)
		elseif(t=='h063')then
			call Qb(u)
		elseif(t=='h008')then
			set t=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))
			set yi[t]=yi[t]-1

		set u=GetKillingUnit()

function nh takes nothing returns boolean

if(GetWidgetLife(u)>.405 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C5')>0)then

if(Vh=='n029')then
call SG(u)
if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0C4')>0 and GetWidgetLife(u)<255.)then
call Dg(u)
else

elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EZ')>0)then

elseif(Vh=='o00E')then

set s=null
return false

limits: No original WC3 runtime or physical Android comparison.

PG uses pre-hit HP in the port. Native nested damage ordering, death damage class, enumeration order, dummy order acceptance, aura cadence/linger and summon replacement timing still require original-engine measurement.
Plague infection acquisition uses a 0.5s port cadence and decay a 0.25s damage step. The 5s death cloud follows Apl3; exact native ward lifetime and refresh/immunity semantics remain unmeasured.
Sphere overrides native projectile art; weapon speed and arc remain from the weapon until original-engine behavior is measured.
Particle billboard/atlas/ribbon and missile Death remain renderer limitations.
